verdict.rationale: Paddle's docs include multiple checkout integration paths (inline/overlay), official SDKs for Node.js, Python, Go and PHP with copy-paste style code and TypeScript support, a sandbox for testing without real payments, and a production-ready Next.js SaaS starter kit that yields 'a working three-tier subscription app' with Paddle checkout and webhooks — directly matching the 'working payment flow in under a day' story across languages. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of the 'under a day' timeframe and broader language coverage beyond the four official SDKs.
